---
title: "Implementations"
subtitle: "Other R virtual machines next to the GNU R they are built on"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
others <- D$runs[D$runs$impl != "gnur" & D$runs$config == "default", ]
others <- others[order(others$date, others$started), ]
IMPLS <- unique(others$impl)

# each run of `impl` on machine `mm` against that machine's run of the GNU R
# release the implementation is built on, over the benchmarks both ran
against_base <- function(impl, mm) {
  r <- others[others$impl == impl & others$machine == mm, ]
  base <- D$runs[D$runs$impl == "gnur" & D$runs$kind == "release" & D$runs$config == "default" &
                 D$runs$machine == mm & D$runs$version == r$base[1], ]
  if (!nrow(r) || !nrow(base)) return(NULL)
  base <- base[order(base$started, decreasing = TRUE)[1], ]   # its latest run
  list(runs = r, base = base, timeline = timeline(D$est, r, base$run))
}
short <- function(sha) substr(sha, 1, 8)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr "length(IMPLS) == 0"
not_yet("Only GNU R is measured so far.")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr "length(IMPLS) > 0"
tagList(lapply(IMPLS, function(impl) {
  machines <- unique(others$machine[others$impl == impl])
  tagList(tags$h2(impl), machine_tabs(machines, function(mm) {
    a <- against_base(impl, mm)
    if (is.null(a)) return(not_yet(paste0("No run of GNU R ", others$base[others$impl == impl][1],
                                          " on this machine to compare with yet.")))
    last <- a$runs[nrow(a$runs), ]
    sp <- speedups(D$est[D$est$run == a$base$run, ], D$est[D$est$run == last$run, ])
    g <- geomean_speedup(sp)
    tl <- a$timeline
    hover <- sprintf("<b>%s %s</b> (%s)<br>%s vs R %s (95%% CI %s–%s)<br>%d benchmarks",
                     impl, short(tl$commit), fmt_date(tl$date), fmt_speedup(tl$speedup),
                     a$base$version, fmt_speedup(tl$lo), fmt_speedup(tl$hi), tl$n)
    fig <- plot_ly(tl, x = ~date, height = 330) |>
      add_ribbons(ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, fillcolor = LIGHT[["band"]], line = list(width = 0),
                  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |>
      add_trace(y = ~speedup, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                line = list(color = LIGHT[["series1"]], width = 2),
                marker = list(color = LIGHT[["series1"]], size = 7),
                text = hover, hoverinfo = "text", showlegend = FALSE) |>
      rs_layout(x = ax(NULL, type = "date"),
                y = speedup_axis(paste("Speedup over GNU R", a$base$version), c(tl$lo, tl$hi)),
                legend = FALSE, shapes = list(baseline_line()))
    by_suite <- do.call(rbind, lapply(SUITES, function(s) {
      ids <- D$benchmarks$id[D$benchmarks$suite == s]
      x <- geomean_speedup(sp, ids)
      if (x$n == 0) NULL else cbind(suite = s, x)
    }))
    sp$suite <- D$benchmarks$suite[match(sp$benchmark, D$benchmarks$id)]
    sp$base_ms <- D$est$est_ms[D$est$run == a$base$run][match(sp$benchmark, D$est$benchmark[D$est$run == a$base$run])]
    sp$new_ms <- D$est$est_ms[D$est$run == last$run][match(sp$benchmark, D$est$benchmark[D$est$run == last$run])]
    sp <- sp[order(-sp$speedup), ]
    unsupported <- setdiff(D$est$benchmark[D$est$run == a$base$run], sp$benchmark)
    tagList(
      tiles(
        tile(paste0("Latest: ", short(last$commit)), fmt_speedup(g$speedup),
             sprintf("over GNU R %s · 95%% CI %s–%s", a$base$version, fmt_speedup(g$lo), fmt_speedup(g$hi))),
        tile("Commit", fmt_date(last$date),
             paste0(if (isTRUE(nzchar(last$ref)) && last$ref != last$commit) paste0(last$ref, " · ") else "",
                    nrow(a$runs), ngettext(nrow(a$runs), " commit measured", " commits measured"))),
        tile("Faster / slower", paste(sum(sp$significant & sp$speedup > 1), "/",
                                      sum(sp$significant & sp$speedup < 1)),
             "benchmarks with a clear change (95% CI, > 2%)"),
        tile("Runs", paste(nrow(sp), "benchmarks"),
             if (length(unsupported)) paste(length(unsupported), "fail on it") else "all of GNU R's")
      ),
      div(class = "rs-card",
        div(class = "rs-card-title", paste("Every commit against GNU R", a$base$version)),
        div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Geometric mean over the benchmarks every commit ran, with its 95% interval; above 1× is faster."),
        fig),
      div(class = "rs-card",
        div(class = "rs-card-title", paste0("By suite (", short(last$commit), ")")),
        rs_table(data.frame(Suite = by_suite$suite, Benchmarks = by_suite$n,
                            Speedup = fmt_speedup(by_suite$speedup),
                            `95% CI` = paste(fmt_speedup(by_suite$lo), "–", fmt_speedup(by_suite$hi)),
                            check.names = FALSE), pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE)),
      div(class = "rs-card",
        div(class = "rs-card-title", paste0("Every benchmark (", short(last$commit), ")")),
        rs_table(data.frame(suite = sp$suite, benchmark = sp$benchmark,
                            `GNU R` = fmt_ms(sp$base_ms), impl = fmt_ms(sp$new_ms),
                            speedup = fmt_speedup(sp$speedup),
                            `95% CI` = paste(fmt_speedup(sp$lo), "–", fmt_speedup(sp$hi)),
                            change = vapply(seq_len(nrow(sp)), function(i) as.character(
                              status(if (!sp$significant[i]) "same" else if (sp$speedup[i] > 1) "faster" else "slower")), ""),
                            check.names = FALSE) |> setNames(c("suite", "benchmark", paste("GNU R", a$base$version),
                                                               impl, "speedup", "95% CI", "change")),
                 searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 20,
                 columns = setNames(list(colDef(minWidth = 230, cell = function(v) tags$a(href = bench_url(v), v)),
                                         colDef(html = TRUE)), c("benchmark", "change"))),
        if (length(unsupported)) p(class = "rs-muted", "Fail on it: ", paste(unsupported, collapse = ", ")))
    )
  }))
}))
```

## All implementations

```{r}
known <- data.frame(
  Implementation = c("GNU R", "rcp", "Ř (PIR)", "FastR"),
  Kind = c("reference interpreter (AST + byte code)", "copy-and-patch JIT (R package on a patched GNU R)",
           "optimising JIT", "GraalVM / Truffle"),
  `Built on` = c("–", "GNU R 4.5.2 (patched)", "GNU R 4.1.1 (patched)", "own"),
  Status = c(as.character(status("validated")),
             if ("rcp" %in% IMPLS) as.character(status("experimental")) else "planned",
             "planned", "planned"),
  check.names = FALSE)
rs_table(known, columns = list(Status = colDef(html = TRUE)), pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE)
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- An implementation other than GNU R is built from a commit of its repository with the compiler and settings of the GNU R release it is built on, and measured by the same harness, run design and code layouts as GNU R, on the same machines, under the same methodology. Its commits are compared with that release, never across machines.
- **rcp:** after a benchmark's `setup()`, before its first iteration, `execute()` is compiled with `rcp_cmpfun()` (optimisation level 3), as rcp's own benchmarks do; what `execute()` calls runs as R runs it. The compilation is outside the measured iterations, as GNU R's byte-compilation of `execute()` is (it happens in the warm-up).
- Profiles are recorded for GNU R only: perf does not see a JIT's generated code without its help, and the category rules know GNU R's interpreter.
- How to add one: `impls/` in the speedR repository.
:::
